resources.string: Online basemap unavailable. Trail recording still works.
Exploration overlay unavailable — unknown areas stay hidden

This build shows the OpenFreeMap basemap, a donation-funded public map service with no availability guarantee. Basemap requests go to OpenFreeMap and reveal the approximate area being viewed; TrailVeil sends no account, identifier or route data with them.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (openstreetmap.org/copyright); tiles by OpenMapTiles and OpenFreeMap. The ⓘ control on the map shows the full attribution. The map is drawn by MapLibre Native (BSD 2-Clause License); its notices ship inside the app.
